definitions.explanation: The state of the economy or business activity.
A sense of vigor or activity.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Business is slow. / The economy is bad.

⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{景気|けいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。

notes:
Primarily refers to the state of the economy (sense 1). Also used figuratively to mean liveliness or energy (sense 2).

COMMON PATTERNS (sense 1):
- {景気|けいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: economy is good/bad
- {景気|けいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: economy recovers
- {景気|けいき}⟦{後退|こうたい}→後退：12556_koutai⟧: economic recession
- {景気|けいき}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: economic measures

SENSE 2 (liveliness):
- {景気|けいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an upbeat/optimistic story
- {景気|けいき}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: in high spirits, vigorously

- ⟦{好景気|こうけいき}→好景気：20446_koukeiki⟧: economic boom
- ⟦{不景気|ふけいき}→不景気：18557_fukeiki⟧: recession, depression
